verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a company-formation SaaS like Atlas, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only shows that incorporation documents can be viewed in the Documents tab of the Atlas Dashboard. Nothing documents a bulk export of all account data, open or machine-readable formats, or an offboarding path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
